title: DIANOIA: Diagnostic Decomposition and Joint Optimization for Multi-Agent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.08586v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems consistently outperform single-agent baselines, yet practitioners still cannot predict which design works for a new task or diagnose why one fails. We argue this gap persists largely because the field lacks a diagnostic framework with measurable primitives and testable predictions. We introduce \textbf{DIANOIA}, a three-channel decomposition of multi-agent reasoning gain into coverage, fidelity, and synthesis, each of which is empirically measurable. translated_title: DIANOIA：多智能体推理的诊断分解与联合优化
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统持续优于单智能体基线，但实践者仍无法预测哪种设计适用于新任务或诊断其失败原因。我们认为，这一差距持续存在的主要原因是该领域缺乏一个具有可测量基元和可测试预测的诊断框架。我们引入了**DIANOIA**，一种将多智能体推理增益分解为覆盖度、保真度和综合三个通道的方法，每个通道均可经验测量。基于此分解，我们推导出一个诊断协议，能够识别任何给定任务中的瓶颈通道。我们将该协议实例化为一个多智能体系统，其三个组件与通道对应：角色多样的提议者用于覆盖度，执行基础的验证用于保真度，以及迭代综合。在GSM8K、AIME-2025、MBPP和BFCL-SP上，我们的方法在匹配token预算下优于强多智能体基线，主导Pareto前沿。
tldr: 本文提出DIANOIA框架，通过将多智能体推理增益分解为覆盖度、保真度和综合三个可测量通道，实现诊断瓶颈并联合优化，从而在多个基准上超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DIANOIA, which decomposes multi-agent reasoning gain into three measurable channels—coverage, fidelity, and synthesis—to diagnose bottlenecks and jointly optimize, outperforming strong baselines on multiple benchmarks.
